quests.name: The Brother Who Went Down
quests.pitch: "My brother Tam went down the stair with the first expedition. Everyone says he's dead. He promised he'd scratch our sign on a wall if he got past the goblins -- a little fox. Will you look for it?"

stages.log: Find the fox sign Tam scratched on Floor 1

find.what: a fox scratched into a wall

stages.say: A small fox, scratched deep with a knife point, and an arrow under it pointing down. He got past the goblins.

stages.log: Follow the arrows down: find what Tam left on Floor 2

find.what: Tam's satchel

stages.say: A satchel with a fox stitched on the flap. Inside: dry bread gone to stone, and a letter folded small. "Rin -- I'm going on. Don't let them say I'm dead."

stages.log: Bring Tam's letter back to Little Rin in Eliet

choices.text: Give her the letter as it is
Tell her he's alive and still going down

truth.say: Rin reads it twice, then folds it smaller. "He said not to let them say it. So I won't." She presses a carved fox into your hand.

hope.say: Rin's face opens like a window. "I knew it." She runs to tell everyone. Later you find a carved fox left on your doorstep.

quests.name: Old Pell's Hammer
quests.pitch: "Forty years I swung a hammer in the warrens before they were warrens. Dropped it running from the first goblins. It's got my name burned in the haft. I'd like it back before I die, if it's not too much bother."

stages.log: A goblin called Haft-Biter carries Pell's hammer on Floor 1. Take it back
stages.say: Haft-Biter falls, and the old hammer rolls out of its grip -- PELL burned in the haft, just as he said.

stages.log: Return the hammer to Old Pell

default.say: Pell holds it like a baby. "Still balanced." He wraps your hand around it once, to feel it, then gives you something better: three of his old whetstones and a trick for using them.

quests.name: A Cure for the Damp Cough
quests.pitch: "Half the village coughs every thaw. The old miners swore by a moss that grows only where the Drowned Seam meets dry stone. Bring me some, and the herbs to bind it, and we'll see if they were right."

stages.log: Find the pale seam-moss on Floor 3

find.what: a clump of pale seam-moss

stages.say: Pale moss, cold as a coin, growing where the water stops.

stages.log: Gather 4 Spirit Herbs to bind the moss
Bring the moss and the herbs to Apothecary Lin

default.say: Lin grinds, boils, sniffs, and laughs. "The old miners were right." She brews a batch for the village and a stronger one for you.

quests.name: The Deserter
quests.pitch: "One of my scouts, Joss, ran from the Sanctum and never came back up. If he's alive he's a deserter, and the law says I bring him in. If he's dead, I want his tag. Find out which."

stages.log: Find out what happened to Joss on Floor 4

find.what: a scout's tag on a broken chain

stages.say: A scout's tag, chain snapped -- and fresh boot prints leading AWAY from it, toward the stair down.

stages.log: Tell Captain Rhee what you found

choices.text: Give her the tag: "He's dead."
Tell her the truth: he ran on, down

dead.say: Rhee takes the tag and closes her fist on it. "Then he's on the wall with the others." She pays you like a scout.

alive.say: Rhee is quiet a long time. "Down," she says. "Not up." She tears the warrant in half. "Then he's not a deserter. He's an expedition of one." She gives you his spare kit.

quests.name: Fen's Lost Load
quests.pitch: "I carry for everyone in Shellhaven. Last trip down to the Grove, the vines took me by the ankle and I dropped the lot. Three bundles. Shellhaven goes hungry without them."

stages.log: Recover Fen's 3 bundles in the Strangling Grove (Floor 6)

find.what: a porter's bundle tangled in vines

stages.say: Another bundle, cut free of the vines.

stages.log: Bring the bundles back to Fen in Shellhaven

default.say: Fen counts them twice and nearly cries. "Mother Kesh will feed you for a month." She does.

quests.name: Mother Kesh's Son
quests.pitch: "My boy Dov went to the Ember Forges to learn smithing from the dead. That was a month ago. The forges don't give back what they take, they say. Prove them wrong."

stages.log: Search the Ember Forges (Floor 7) for Dov

find.what: a scorched leather apron

stages.say: A scorched apron, with DOV burned into the strap -- and beside it, a smith's mark chalked fresh on the wall: he's moved deeper into the forges.

stages.log: Something holds Dov at the deep anvils: kill the Slag-Warden
stages.say: The Slag-Warden crashes down. Behind it, a thin, sooty boy with a hammer, very surprised to see you.

stages.log: Tell Mother Kesh her son is alive

default.say: Kesh doesn't say anything at all. She just holds on to you, hard. Later Dov brings you the first thing he forged on his own.

quests.name: The Names in the Clay
quests.pitch: "The terracotta soldiers on Floor 8 each had a name pressed into the clay. My grandmother's family is down there. I want their names -- five tablets -- so someone remembers."

stages.log: Collect 5 name-tablets in the Terracotta Barrows (Floor 8)

find.what: a clay name-tablet

stages.say: A small tablet. A name, pressed by a thumb a thousand years ago.

stages.log: Bring the tablets to Ysolde

choices.text: Give all five to Ysolde
Suggest they go back where they lay

keep.say: Ysolde reads each name aloud. Her grandmother's name is the third. She cries, and gives you the only valuable thing she has.

return.say: Ysolde copies every name onto paper, then asks you to take the tablets back. "They should stay with their soldiers." When you lay them down, the barrow goes quiet in a way it wasn't before.

quests.name: An Oath at the Sword Grave
quests.pitch: "Every warden of Shellhaven swore an oath at the Sword Grave. The oath-stone was broken by something big. Nobody's sworn since. Clear the way, and bring me a shard of the stone."

stages.log: Clear the way: defeat 12 foes in the Sword Grave (Floor 9)
stages.say: The halls of the Sword Grave are quieter.

stages.log: Find a shard of the broken oath-stone

find.what: a shard of the oath-stone

stages.say: A shard of grey stone, still warm, the words OATH and HOLD half-cut into it.

stages.log: Bring the shard to Warden Tolle

default.say: Tolle sets the shard on the gatehouse wall and swears the old oath over it -- and, because you're standing there, makes you swear it too.

quests.name: The Last Ferry
quests.pitch: "My ferry ran to the Drowned Palace before the water rose. The palace bell still rings down there, they say, when no one's pulling it. Ring it three times and the old ferry-spirits lead the drowned home. Will you?"

stages.log: Find the bell rope in the Drowned Palace (Floor 11)

find.what: the palace bell's rope

stages.say: A rope of rotten silk -- and above it, in the dark, a bell.

stages.log: The drowned won't let you ring it in peace: defeat 10 foes in the palace
stages.say: The drowned fall back from the bell.

stages.log: Tell Ilse the bell has rung

default.say: "I heard it," Ilse says. "All the way up here." She lights a lantern on the water for every name she can remember, and gives you the ferry's old lamp.

quests.name: Corin's Debt
quests.pitch: "I owe the Hollow Clans for a beast I lost. Their hunter, Red-Mane, says I pay in blood or in pelts. Bring me four pelts from the Crimson Canopy, and I live."

stages.log: Hunt the Crimson Matriarch in the Canopy (Floor 12) for a prime pelt
stages.say: The Matriarch falls. Her pelt alone is worth the debt twice over.

stages.log: Bring the pelt to Corin

choices.text: Let Corin pay the Clans with it
Take it to the Clans yourself and speak for him

pay.say: Corin pays his debt and keeps his life. "I won't forget it." He doesn't -- he sells to you cheap ever after.

speak.say: Red-Mane takes the pelt from YOUR hands, and looks at you a long time. "The debt is paid. And you -- you hunt like one of us."

quests.name: Letters from the Cloud Palace
quests.pitch: "My great-grandfather was a clerk in the Fallen Cloud Palace when it fell. He wrote to his wife every day. She never got them. They're still in his desk, I'd bet. Four letters is all I ask."

stages.log: Find 4 of the clerk's letters in the Fallen Cloud Palace (Floor 13)

find.what: a sealed letter, never sent

stages.say: A letter in neat, tired handwriting: "...the palace sways more every day. Kiss the children. I will come down the stair soon..."

stages.log: Bring the letters to Agna

default.say: Agna reads them by her own lanterns, one each night, she says, until they're done. She makes you a lantern with a line from the last letter cut into its shade.

quests.name: Spore-Lung
quests.pitch: "Three of our divers came back from the Spore-Choked Deeps coughing green. I can make a cure, but only from the heart of a spore-mother. And I need you to brew the base yourself -- my hands shake now."

stages.log: Kill a Spore-Mother in the Spore-Choked Deeps (Floor 14) and take its heart
stages.say: The Spore-Mother bursts in a cloud of grey. Its heart is the size of a fist, still pulsing.

stages.log: Brew a Healing Salve as the base of the cure (medicine)
Bring the heart and the salve to Wren

default.say: Wren works all night. In the morning the divers are breathing clean. "You've a healer's hands," she says, "whatever else you are."

quests.name: Lightning in a Rod
quests.pitch: "Ironroot's forges run on stolen lightning -- copper rods we planted at the top of the Thunderhead Spire. The storm-things tore three of them down. Plant new ones."

stages.log: Plant new rods: reach 3 empty sockets on the Thunderhead Spire (Floor 16)

find.what: an empty rod-socket at the spire's peak

stages.say: You set a new copper rod in the socket. Somewhere far below, Ironroot's forges roar.

stages.log: Tell Inge the rods are planted

default.say: Inge grins with all her teeth. "Hear that? That's the hold breathing again." She tempers your weapon in lightning, for luck.

quests.name: A Scale from the Sleeping Dragon
quests.pitch: "They say the Spine of the Sleeping Dragon is just rock that looks like a dragon. I say it's a dragon. Bring me a scale from its spine and I'll eat my beard."

stages.log: Find a loose scale on the Spine of the Sleeping Dragon (Floor 17)

find.what: a loose scale, warm to the touch

stages.say: Not rock. A scale the size of a door, warm as a hearth, and under it, very faintly, something breathing.

stages.log: Show the scale to Brokk

default.say: Brokk looks at it for a long time. Then, with great dignity, he trims one braid of his beard and eats it. The whole hold cheers. He has the scale made into a guard for your arm.

quests.name: The Miner's Last Seam
quests.pitch: "My partner died in the Fallen Star Mine, but not before he found a seam of star iron so pure it sang. He marked the way with chalk. Follow his chalk, finish his work, and the ore's half yours."

stages.log: Follow the partner's chalk marks through the Fallen Star Mine (Floor 18)

find.what: a chalk mark: two crossed picks

stages.say: Two crossed picks in chalk, and an arrow.

stages.log: Something lairs in the singing seam: kill the Seam-Eater
stages.say: It falls. Behind it, the seam: silver-blue, humming.

stages.log: Tell Marn the seam is clear

default.say: Marn sends a crew down within the hour. Your half is waiting when they come back up -- and Marn's partner's own pick, which he says should go to someone who finished the work.

quests.name: The Bellringer's Missing Notes
quests.pitch: "The Pagoda's great bell has nine notes. Thieves took three of the striking-stones to the Clockwork Vaults to make their machines tick. Without them the bell is a cripple."

stages.log: Recover 3 striking-stones from the Clockwork Vaults (Floor 21)

find.what: a jade striking-stone

stages.say: A jade striking-stone, still ringing faintly from the last time it was struck.

stages.log: Bring the stones to Yao

default.say: Yao strikes all nine notes. Every disciple in the Pagoda stops and listens. "Now," he says, "you'll always know your way home -- just listen for it."

quests.name: Silk for the Lady
quests.pitch: "The Weaver's Halls spin a silk that turns a blade. The weavers are not kind about sharing. Bring me their queen's spinneret, and I'll make you a robe fit for the Pagoda."

stages.log: Kill the Weaver Queen in the Weaver's Halls (Floor 22)
stages.say: The Queen collapses into her own silk. Her spinneret still glistens.

stages.log: Bring the spinneret to Lady Xiu

default.say: Lady Xiu works the silk for nine days. What she gives you is lighter than cloth and harder than leather.

quests.name: The Lost Index
quests.pitch: "The Frozen Archive holds every technique the old sects ever wrote down. Useless without the index -- six ice-sealed codex keys. Find them, and the Pagoda's library will open its back shelves to you."

stages.log: Find 6 codex keys in the Frozen Archive (Floor 24)

find.what: an ice-sealed codex key

stages.say: A key of clear ice that does not melt in your hand.

stages.log: Bring the keys to Elder Bai

default.say: Bai opens the back shelves. In the dust you find a scroll on breathing that makes your meridians ache with recognition.

quests.name: The Disciple in the Mirror
quests.pitch: "My twin walked into the Mirror Labyrinth and a copy of her walked out. It smiles wrong. The real one's still in there, I know it. Find her -- and find the thing wearing her face."

stages.log: Find and destroy the thing wearing Rou's sister's face (Floor 25)
stages.say: It shatters like glass, still smiling.

stages.log: Search the labyrinth for the real sister

find.what: a jade hairpin by a mirror

stages.say: A jade hairpin on the floor before a tall mirror -- and in the mirror, a girl, waving. The glass is cold and thin. It breaks, and she steps through.

stages.log: Bring Rou's sister home

default.say: The twins hold each other and don't let go. Rou gives you the hairpin. "Mirrors won't hold you," she says. "Not while you wear it."

quests.name: A Debt at the Night Market
quests.pitch: "I bought something at the Night Market of the Dead. I paid in years instead of coin -- a joke, I thought. Now my hair is going white. Find the ghost who sold it and buy my years back."

stages.log: Find the ghost-merchant's ledger in the Night Market (Floor 26)

find.what: a ghost-merchant's ledger

stages.say: A ledger of names and years. LIN: 11 YEARS. The ink is still wet.

stages.log: Make the Year-Broker give the years back
stages.say: The Year-Broker comes apart into ledger pages and laughter. Lin's line in the ledger fades to nothing.

stages.log: Tell Lin her years are hers again

default.say: Lin's hair is black again by the morning. She sells you anything you want at cost, forever, and makes you promise never to buy anything at that market.

quests.name: The Last Egg
quests.pitch: "The firebirds of the Nest lay one egg in a hundred years. Thieves took it to the Glass Dunes to sell. If it cools, it dies -- and so, slowly, do we."

stages.log: Run down the egg-thief in the Glass Dunes (Floor 32)
stages.say: The thief drops; the egg rolls free in the ash, still warm. Barely.

stages.log: Bring the egg home to Mother Sorrel before it cools

default.say: Sorrel lays the egg in the hearth-nest and everyone in the Nest stops breathing until it pulses once, bright. A firebird feather drifts down to you from somewhere above.

quests.name: The Song that Broke
quests.pitch: "The Singing Caverns used to sing one long chord you could hear in the Nest. Now it's two notes fighting. Something's cracked a resonant crystal. Mend it -- I'll teach you the tuning words."

stages.log: Find the cracked resonant crystals in the Deep Singing Caverns (Floor 34)

find.what: a cracked resonant crystal

stages.say: You speak the tuning word. The crystal hums, cracks shut, and joins the chord.

stages.log: Tell Embera the caverns sing again

default.say: Embera closes her eyes. "There. One chord." She teaches you the last tuning word, the one that is just for you.

quests.name: A Duel for Ves
quests.pitch: "The storm-king of the Stormbreak Stair burned my brother to ash and calls it a duel won. I'm not strong enough to answer him. You might be. Answer for me."

stages.log: Answer the Storm-King on the Stormbreak Stair (Floor 36)
stages.say: The Storm-King falls, and the thunder stops for the first time in a hundred years.

stages.log: Tell Ves it is answered

default.say: Ves doesn't cheer. He lights one candle for his brother. Then he gives you his brother's flame -- a coal that never goes out.

quests.name: The Bells of Silence
quests.pitch: "Our order keeps silence because the Deep listens. Seven silent bells hold the Hollow Moon together. Someone has been ringing them. Find them in the Thawed Archive and still them."

stages.log: Still 7 silent bells in the Thawed Archive (Floor 42)

find.what: a bell ringing with no sound

stages.say: You lay your hand on the bell. The sound you could not hear stops -- and you realise you'd been hearing it all along.

stages.log: Return to Old Mother Silence

default.say: She says nothing at all -- she can't -- but she bows to you, lower than she has bowed to anyone in forty years, and puts a silent bell of your own in your hand.

quests.name: The Pilgrim's Road
quests.pitch: "I walk to the Heart of the Deep -- every pilgrim does, once. But the shrines on the way are dark. Light them for me, three of them, and I'll walk the rest myself."

stages.log: Light 3 wayshrines in the First Machine (Floor 43)

find.what: a dark wayshrine

stages.say: You light the shrine. A small flame, but in the dark of the deep you can see it a long way.

stages.log: Light 3 more wayshrines on the Still Spire (Floor 45)

find.what: a dark wayshrine

stages.say: Another flame on the long road down.

stages.log: Tell Ren the road is lit

default.say: Ren shoulders her pack. "Then I'll see you at the bottom," she says, and means it. She leaves you her walking-prayer, written on a strip of cloth.

quests.name: The Abbot's Doubt
quests.pitch: "I have kept this monastery sixty years believing the Heart of the Deep is holy. A brother came back from the Cooling Dunes and said it is only hungry. Bring me what he saw: the carving at the dune's heart."

stages.log: Make a rubbing of the carving in the Cooling Dunes (Floor 46)

find.what: an ancient carving, half-buried

stages.say: A carving of the Heart -- and around it, people, kneeling, being drawn in. Holy, or hungry. It could be either.

stages.log: Bring the rubbing to Abbot Lune

choices.text: "It's holy. Keep your faith."
"It's hungry. Tell your brothers the truth."

faith.say: Lune nods slowly, and you can see what it costs him. "Then we keep the vigil." The monastery keeps its quiet; he blesses you before you go.

truth.say: Lune burns sixty years of sermons in one night. In the morning the brothers start sharpening swords instead of prayers. "If it's hungry," he says, "we'll be ready when it wakes."

quests.name: The Apprentice's Anvil
quests.pitch: "You want to swing a sword, you ought to know what's in one. Grind me three whetstones and beat out an iron sword. Not a good one. Just one that holds."

stages.log: Make 3 Whetstones at a bench (smithing)
Forge an Iron Sword
Show your work to Smith Hale

default.say: Hale flexes the blade over his knee. It holds. "Ugly," he says, pleased. "Keep the hammer. You'll want your own."

quests.name: Bone and Iron
quests.pitch: "Hale sent you? Hm. Shellhaven smiths work what the deep gives us -- bone, chitin, slag. Show me you can make bone take an edge, and make something that's better than plain."

stages.log: Reach Smithing 4
Forge a Bone Blade
Make any smithing piece of Fine quality or better
Bring it to Dagna Ironvent

default.say: Dagna turns the piece in the forge-light and grunts approval. She gives you her old tongs -- "they know where to hold".

quests.name: Pearl and Steel
quests.pitch: "Lanternmere steel is folded with pearl-grit from the lake. Bring me ore, make five pieces at my anvil to get the feel of it, then fold me spirit steel."

stages.log: Gather 10 Iron Ore
Make 5 smithing pieces
Forge a Spirit Steel Sword
Bring the sword to Haldor Rivet

default.say: Haldor rings the blade with his knuckle and listens a long time. "You've got the rhythm." He teaches you the Lanternmere fold.

quests.name: The Holloway Masterwork
quests.pitch: "Every smith in Ironroot makes one Superior piece before they're called a smith here. The good ones use star iron from the Fallen Star Mine. Bring some up and make yours."

stages.log: Reach Smithing 14
Bring up star iron from the Fallen Star Mine (Floor 18)

find.what: a lump of fallen star iron

stages.say: Star iron: heavy as a promise, cold even in your hand.

stages.log: Make a Superior smithing piece
Show Ada Holloway your masterwork

default.say: Ada hangs your piece on the guild wall with the others. "Smith," she says, and the whole forge says it after her.

quests.name: A Blade Worth a Bell
quests.pitch: "I cast bells. A bell is a blade that sings instead of cuts. Make me a Masterwork -- anything -- and I'll tell you the secret of the temper that makes both."

stages.log: Reach Smithing 24
Make a Masterwork smithing piece
Let Yao strike your masterwork

default.say: Yao strikes it once. It rings like one of his bells, clear and long. He teaches you the bell-temper, and the Pagoda calls you master.

quests.name: Forged in Firebird Flame
quests.pitch: "The Nest's forge burns on a firebird's breath. Only a grandmaster may work it. Make eight pieces at the grandmaster's pace and one Masterwork from the deep's own metal, and the flame is yours to use."

stages.log: Reach Smithing 40
Make 8 smithing pieces
Make another Masterwork
Bring your work to Bryn Feather

default.say: Bryn opens the firebird forge for you. The flame bends toward your hammer like a cat to a hand.

quests.name: First Fire
quests.pitch: "Alchemy starts with incense and patience. Burn me a stick of qi incense, then three qi pills -- and don't blow up my shop."

stages.log: Make Qi Incense (alchemy)
Make 3 Qi Pills
Bring the pills to Apothecary Lin

default.say: Lin sniffs each pill, bites one in half, and nods. "Edible. That's a start." She gives you her second-best mortar.

quests.name: The Seven Jars
quests.pitch: "Seven jars, seven roots, seven fires. You've learned one. Bring me ember root and iron thistle from below, and brew me an ember pill and a thistle pill."

stages.log: Gather 3 Ember Root
Gather 3 Iron Thistle
Brew an Ember Pill
Brew a Thistle Pill
Bring both pills to Lio

default.say: Lio sets your pills in two of his seven jars. "Five to go," he says, "and you have the rest of your life." He teaches you jar-keeping.

quests.name: Salt and Breath
quests.pitch: "Divers need breath more than courage. Brew me a deep breath pill, and then brew anything well -- Fine or better. I want to see care, not luck."

stages.log: Reach Alchemy 6
Brew a Deep Breath Pill
Brew any alchemy of Fine quality or better
Return to Wren

default.say: "Care," Wren says, satisfied. "Not luck." She gives you a pouch of her salt -- it keeps every pill you carry from spoiling, she claims.

quests.name: Earthmarrow
quests.pitch: "Ironroot alchemy is slow alchemy. The earthmarrow pill takes the deep's own patience. Show me five brews and one earthmarrow."

stages.log: Reach Alchemy 12
Brew 5 alchemy recipes
Brew an Earthmarrow Pill
Show Pell Ironroot the earthmarrow

default.say: Pell weighs it in his palm. "Heavy. Good." He teaches you the root-fire, the slow heat that never scorches.

quests.name: The Pagoda's Elixir
quests.pitch: "The heartfire elixir is the Pagoda's pride. Brew one, and brew something Superior, and I will put your name in the furnace-book."

stages.log: Reach Alchemy 20
Brew a Heartfire Elixir
Brew a Superior alchemy piece
Bring your work to Sister Qing

default.say: Sister Qing writes your name in the furnace-book in her neatest hand, two lines below her own master's.

quests.name: The Ash Pill
quests.pitch: "Every grandmaster makes one Masterwork pill and eats it in front of their teacher. If it's poison, you weren't a grandmaster. Your turn."

stages.log: Reach Alchemy 36
Brew a Masterwork alchemy piece
Eat your Masterwork in front of Ruan

default.say: You eat it. You don't die. Ruan laughs until he coughs ash. "Grandmaster!"

quests.name: Mender's Hands
quests.pitch: "I've mended Lanternmere's hurts forty years and my hands shake now. Make me four remedies, then an ironskin salve, and take it to Brin -- his back's been bad since the storm."

stages.log: Make 4 medicines
Make an Ironskin Salve
Take the salve to Brin Saltfoot
stages.say: Brin groans as it goes on, then straightens up for the first time in a month. "Tell Pell I owe him a fish."

stages.log: Tell Old Mender Pell it worked

default.say: Pell nods slowly. "Good hands." He gives you his own, older remedy book, notes in three different inks.

quests.name: Broth for the Hold
quests.pitch: "The miners come up grey. Bone broth puts colour back in a face. Make me three pots and I'll feed the whole shift."

stages.log: Make 3 Bone Broths
Bring the broth to Ulla Rootsong

default.say: Ulla ladles it out to a long line of grey faces. They go pink. The miners raise their bowls to you.

quests.name: Resin and Rest
quests.pitch: "Pilgrims arrive here with their feet in ribbons. The old resin salve heals in a night, but nobody here can make it any more. Can you?"

stages.log: Reach Medicine 10
Make 2 Resin Salves
Bring the salves to Sister Lumiara

default.say: Lumiara treats a pilgrim's feet while you watch. By morning he's walking. "There," she says. "Now we can make it again -- you showed me."

quests.name: A Lucky Charm
quests.pitch: "Sailors buy luck before they buy rope. Cut me two lucky charms and I'll sell them by evening -- and pay you more than they're worth."

stages.log: Make 2 Lucky Charms (jewelcrafting)
Bring the charms to Cassiel Vane

default.say: Cassiel sells both before you've finished your tea, and pays you double. "Luck," he says, "is a very good business."

quests.name: Jade for Jade-Hand
quests.pitch: "They call me Jade-Hand because I can tell real jade from glass blind. Can you cut it? Make me a jade ring, and something of Fine quality."

stages.log: Cut a Jade Ring
Make any jewelcrafting piece of Fine quality
Show Lin Jade-Hand your work

default.say: Lin closes her eyes and runs a thumb over the ring. "Real," she says. "And cut by real hands." She gives you her loupe.

quests.name: The Emperor's Pendant
quests.pitch: "An old buyer wants an emperor-jade pendant. Nobody in Ironroot can cut one. If you can, you'll be the only jeweller below Lanternmere worth the name."

stages.log: Reach Jewelcrafting 8
Cut an Emperor Jade Pendant
Bring the pendant to Sigrid Lamplow

default.say: Sigrid holds it to her lamp and goes very quiet. She pays you more gold than you've seen at once.

quests.name: Pick of the Warrens
quests.pitch: "Herbs and ore -- that's what moves in Eliet. Bring me a good haul from below and I'll pay you a fair price and a little more."

stages.log: Pick 8 herbs anywhere in the deep
Mine 5 ore veins
Come back to Trader Wen

default.say: Wen counts it out with a merchant's quick fingers, then pushes a little extra back to you. "For the next one."

quests.name: Ore for the Smelters
quests.pitch: "The smelters are cold. Twelve veins' worth of ore and they'll run all winter."

stages.log: Mine 12 ore veins
Tell Thora the smelters can light

default.say: Thora lights the smelters herself. Shellhaven is warm that night.

quests.name: Saltwater Fishing
quests.pitch: "The lake's full of blind fish that taste like the sky. Catch me six and I'll show you where the big ones sleep."

stages.log: Catch 6 fish anywhere in the deep
Bring your catch to Brin Saltfoot

default.say: Brin guts them in a blink and fries them on a flat stone. Then, as promised, he gives you the hook that catches the big ones.

quests.name: Gems of the Deep
quests.pitch: "The glittering veins give gems to those with patience. Six veins, and I'll teach you to read the stone before you strike it."

stages.log: Chip 6 glittering veins
Come back to Tomas Deepwell

default.say: Tomas shows you how a vein leans, where it cracks clean. You'll never waste a strike again.

quests.name: Moonpetals for Mother
quests.pitch: "My mother's eyes are going. The healers say moonpetal tea. I can't go down there. Please? Six flowers."

stages.log: Gather 6 Moonpetals
Bring the moonpetals to Little Bo

default.say: Bo runs off without a word. Two days later his mother finds you and holds your face in her hands, looking at you clearly.

quests.name: A Garden in the Nest
quests.pitch: "Nothing grows in the Nest -- too hot. But you've a garden up top, they say. Grow something and bring me the seed of it."

stages.log: Harvest your home garden 5 times
Bring seed from your garden to Ottilie Warm

default.say: Ottilie plants them in ash and they come up blue. The Nest's first garden in a thousand years.

quests.name: Old Grudges
quests.pitch: "Smith Hale and I haven't spoken in nine years. Over a pot. A POT. Talk to him, would you? I'm too proud and so is he."

stages.log: Hear Smith Hale's side of it
stages.say: Hale snorts. "It wasn't about the pot. She sold my father's anvil to a stranger. The pot was just the last thing."

stages.log: Go back to Trader Wen

choices.text: "It was never about the pot. Apologise for the anvil."
"He's right. You owe him."
"He's stubborn. Let him stew."

peace.say: Wen goes very red, then very quiet, then walks across the square to the forge. Neither of them says much. But the next morning there's a new pot on Hale's fire.

hale.say: Wen scowls, but she pays Hale for the anvil -- with interest. Hale shakes your hand so hard it hurts.

wen.say: Wen nods grimly. "I knew it." She slips you a discount. Hale doesn't look at you for a week.

quests.name: Rin's Friend
quests.pitch: "Everyone in the village is old. Will you be my friend? A real one -- you have to come and talk to me, not just pass by."

stages.log: Become Little Rin's friend (talk with her often)
Tell Little Rin she has a friend

default.say: Rin gives you the most serious handshake in the history of Eliet. "Friends," she says. Then she teaches you how she finds everything: you look where nobody looks.

quests.name: A Night at the Brask
quests.pitch: "An innkeeper hears everything. Stay a few nights, talk to people. Shellhaven's friendlier than it looks -- you just have to sit down."

stages.log: Rest at inns three times
Talk with 6 people in Shellhaven
Tell Hollin Brask what you heard

default.say: Hollin pours you the good stuff. "Now you're a regular." Regulars eat free on festival days.

quests.name: The Matchmaker
quests.pitch: "Captain Vey and the lampkeeper have been making eyes at each other for two years and neither will say a word. Carry a message, would you? And bring a lantern -- it's romantic."

stages.log: Bring a Spirit Lantern
Give Captain Vey the lantern (from someone who admires him)
stages.say: Vey turns the lantern over, and turns very red. "From... who?"

stages.log: Go back to Mother Orla

choices.text: Tell Vey the truth: it's from the lampkeeper
Let him guess

truth.say: Within a week the whole of Lanternmere is invited to a wedding on the water. Orla cries at it. So does Vey.

mystery.say: Vey spends a month asking everyone. When he finally asks the lampkeeper, she says yes before he finishes the question.

quests.name: The Quiet One
quests.pitch: (Gorm doesn't say anything. He just looks at you, then at the empty stool beside him.)

stages.log: Earn Gorm the Quiet's friendship (spend time with him)
Sit with Gorm one more time

default.say: Gorm finally speaks. Six words: "Listen to the stone. It talks." Then he shows you how, and you hear it -- the hollow behind a wall, the beast in the next room.

quests.name: Ninefold Tea
quests.pitch: "Old Sun and Elder Bai have argued about tea for sixty years. Bring each of them qi incense from me, and see if a gift can end a war."

stages.log: Bring 2 Qi Incense
Give Old Sun the incense
stages.say: Old Sun sniffs it. "Feng sent this? Hm. Bai would never think of it."

stages.log: Give Elder Bai the incense
stages.say: Elder Bai laughs out loud. "Old Sun would never think of it!"

stages.log: Tell Feng how it went

choices.text: "Invite them both to tea. Together."
"Let them keep their war. It keeps them young."

tea.say: The three old men drink tea together for the first time in sixty years and argue about it happily all afternoon.

war.say: Feng grins. "You're right. What would they do without each other to hate?" The argument goes on, cheerfully.

quests.name: Letters Home
quests.pitch: "I left Eliet forty years ago to join the order and never wrote. My sister was Elder Mo's wife. Take him a letter for me -- I haven't the courage to go up the stair."

stages.log: Carry Brother Ash's letter up to Elder Mo in Eliet
stages.say: Mo reads it twice. His hands shake. "Ash? He's alive?" He writes back that same night.

stages.log: Bring Elder Mo's answer back down to Brother Ash

default.say: Ash reads Mo's letter on the monastery steps and weeps without hiding it. "He forgives me," he keeps saying. "He forgives me."

quests.name: Rhee's Drill
quests.pitch: "My scouts live because they don't get hit. Roll through fifteen blows, and turn five aside with your guard at the last instant. Then we'll talk."

stages.log: Roll through 15 attacks (Ctrl)
Parry 5 attacks (raise your guard just as the blow lands)
Report to Captain Rhee

default.say: Rhee nods once. "Scout's feet." She drills you one more hour until it's in your bones.

quests.name: The Breaking Stance
quests.pitch: "Strength is nothing. Breaking is everything. Stagger ten foes -- wear their balance down until they reel -- and I'll show you where to stand."

stages.log: Stagger 10 foes (break their poise)
Return to Circle-Keeper Venn

default.say: Venn places your feet with his own hands. "Here. And here. Now hit." The training dummy breaks in half.

quests.name: The Elite Hunter
quests.pitch: "Any fool kills goblins. The marked ones -- the elites, the ones that glow -- those are a hunter's work. Five of them."

stages.log: Defeat 5 elite foes (the ones that glow)
Report to Captain Vey

default.say: Vey shows you where the elites hide their weakness -- always a little to the left of where you'd look.

quests.name: Sit Like Stone
quests.pitch: "The moss grows on the stone because the stone sits still. Open three points of your meridian lattice by sitting. Then sit with me."

stages.log: Open 3 points of the Meridian Lattice (K, then meditate)
Sit with Kettil Moss

default.say: You sit with Kettil for an hour. Neither of you moves. When you stand, the qi in your meridians has settled like silt in still water.

quests.name: The Ninefold Form
quests.pitch: "An art you only know is a tool. An art you've grown is a limb. Grow your arts -- three new stages of mastery -- and I'll teach you the form that joins them."

stages.log: Grow your arts: reach 3 new art stages (use them in fights)
Return to Master Ou

default.say: Master Ou shows you the ninefold form: every art flowing into the next. Your arts feel lighter after, as if they'd always wanted to be used together.

quests.name: The Old Way
quests.pitch: "Floor masters. The great ones. Kill two -- properly, face to face -- and an old man will tell you how he lived so long."

stages.log: Defeat 2 floor masters
Return to Old Kael

default.say: "You don't win by hitting harder," Kael says. "You win by being there at the end." He teaches you to take a blow like an old tree takes the wind.

quests.name: The Silent Strike
quests.pitch: (Sister Hush writes on a slate: "Thirty in the Black Canopy. Without a word. Then come back.")

stages.log: Defeat 30 foes in the Black Canopy (Floor 41)
Return to Sister Hush

default.say: Sister Hush writes one more line: "The blade that makes no sound is the one they never see." Then she shows you.

quests.name: Beast Tamer
quests.pitch: "A beast that eats from your hand is worth ten that bite it. Feed five beasts, and win one over for good."

stages.log: Feed wild beasts by hand 5 times (raw meat)
Win a beast over (a contract beast)
Show Netmaster Joss your beast

default.say: Joss scratches your beast behind the ears and it lets him. "Good bond," he says. He teaches you the Netmaster's whistle.

quests.name: The Hold's Larder
quests.pitch: "Ironroot eats what the Spire's beasts don't. Hunt twenty on the Thunderhead Spire and we'll eat this winter."

stages.log: Hunt 20 beasts on the Thunderhead Spire (Floor 16)
stages.say: The Hold's larder is full.

stages.log: Report to Dagny Stone

default.say: Dagny hangs the last haunch and sends you off with a hunter's share and a hunter's oil.

quests.name: Ember Drakes
quests.pitch: "The drakes on the Dragon's Ribs have been taking our firebirds' eggs. Thin them out. Fifteen."

stages.log: Thin the drakes on the Dragon's Ribs (Floor 31)
stages.say: The drakes keep away from the Nest now.

stages.log: Report to Corrin Hearth

default.say: Corrin gives you a drake-tooth arrowhead strung on a cord: "So the next one knows who you are."

quests.name: Light the Way Down
quests.pitch: "Every secret door you find, I mark on my map so the next walker doesn't miss it. Find me five -- and open ten chests while you're at it, so I know what's worth the trip."

stages.log: Find 5 hidden passages
Open 10 chests
Bring your findings to Tamsin

default.say: Tamsin copies your finds onto her great map, then gives you a copy of her own: every secret she's ever marked.

quests.name: The Codex of Old Stones
quests.pitch: "The old stones on every floor remember something. Read six of them and tell me what they say. I'm collecting the deep's memory, one stone at a time."

stages.log: Read 6 old stones (lore stones)
Tell Halla Vein-Eye what the stones said

default.say: Halla writes until her lamp burns down. "You read them right," she says. "Most people don't."

quests.name: Maps of the Deep
quests.pitch: "I sell maps. Bad ones, mostly. Get down to the Mirror Labyrinth, and see three of the deep's great sights along the way, and I'll sell good ones."

stages.log: Reach the Mirror Labyrinth (Floor 25)
See 3 of the deep's great sights (landmarks)
Tell Zhen Clearwater what you saw

default.say: Zhen draws for three days. The maps he sells after are the best in the deep, and the first copy is yours.

quests.name: To the Bottom
quests.pitch: "No one from this monastery has seen the Heart and come back to describe it. Go to the last floor before it and tell me what the air is like."

stages.log: Reach the Last Terrace (Floor 49)
Tell Sister Pale what the bottom is like

default.say: "Warm," you tell her, "and listening." Sister Pale writes it down, and gives you the monastery's oldest blessing.

reward.title: One Who Went to the Bottom

quests.name: Iron in the Blood
quests.pitch: Master Wei looks at your hands before your face. "Soft. Bring me five lumps of iron from below, and put one of the valley's strutting disciples on his back. Then we'll talk about whether you're worth a trial."

stages.log: Bring up 5 Iron Ore
Win a bout against a rival disciple on the valley road
Bring the iron to Master Wei

default.say: Wei weighs the ore in one hand. "Iron doesn't lie about what it is. Neither did you." He presses a ring of black iron into your palm. "Wear it until you can break it."

quests.name: The Hundred Blows
quests.pitch: "Outer disciples are hammers that haven't been struck yet. Turn aside ten blows. Climb two floors of a tower. Give the stores what metal you carry. Then tell Lan you're done -- she keeps the count."

stages.log: Turn aside 10 blows (parry)
Clear 2 floors of any valley tower
Give the sect's stores your metal (talk to Master Wei)
Report to Disciple Lan

default.say: Lan makes a tally mark on the training post, the hundredth on it. She ties the clan's black hand-wraps round your fists herself. "Now you're one of us. Don't make me regret it."

quests.name: The Broken Gauntlet
quests.pitch: Wei doesn't look up. "Disciple Hu went to the Sword Grave to prove he could take a blade from it. He came back without his gauntlet and won't say why. The clan's honour is in that gauntlet. Fetch it -- and whatever took it."

stages.log: Find Hu's gauntlet in the Sword Grave (Floor 9)

find.what: a dented iron gauntlet

stages.say: Hu's gauntlet, split along the knuckles. Something with an edge did this -- and kept going.

stages.log: Defeat the Grave-Edge Revenant that took it
stages.say: The revenant comes apart blade by blade. Somewhere in the grave a sword stops humming.

stages.log: Bring the gauntlet back to Disciple Hu

choices.text: "Tell Master Wei the truth. I'll stand with you."
"Nobody needs to know. Here -- it's yours."

truth.say: Hu confesses on his knees in the yard. Wei hears him out, then, to everyone's shock, bows to him -- and to you. "A fist that can open is stronger than one that can't." He teaches you the Hundred-Blow Body that night.

cover.say: Hu grips your arm. "I won't forget." He doesn't: he teaches you the Hundred-Blow Body himself, in the caves at night, the way he learned it -- and a little extra the master never showed him.

quests.name: The Founder's Fist
quests.pitch: "Our founder, Iron Gate Kuo, climbed the Thunderhead Spire to temper her fist in lightning. She never came down. You're Core now. Go up where she went and bring back what's left of her."

stages.log: Reach the Thunderhead Spire (Floor 16)
Find Iron Gate Kuo's last stand in the Thunderhead Spire

find.what: a gauntlet fused to the rock

stages.say: A gauntlet welded to the stone by a lightning strike, the fist still clenched. You have to break the rock to free it.

stages.log: Defeat the Storm-Bound Guardian that keeps her
stages.say: The guardian falls, and the thunder overhead goes quiet for the first time in a hundred years.

stages.log: Bring the Founder's Fist home to Master Wei

default.say: Wei holds the gauntlet a long time. Then he puts it back in your hands. "She'd want it on a fist, not a shelf. Yours."

quests.name: Succession of Iron
quests.pitch: "I'm old. The clan needs to know who comes after. Stand on the summit of a tower. Beat five of the valley's best on the road. Then go down to the deep spire and finish what Kuo started. Come back and I'll ask you one question."

stages.log: Stand on the summit of a valley tower
Win 5 bouts on the valley road
Defeat the Thunder Sovereign in the Stormbreak Stair (Floor 36)
stages.say: The Sovereign's last bolt grounds through your fist and out through your feet. You're still standing.

stages.log: Answer Master Wei's question

choices.text: "I'll stay. The clan comes first."
"I'll carry the fist out into the world."

heir.say: Wei names you his successor before the whole clan, and teaches you the Unbending Iron Canon, which only the head of the Iron Fist may know.

wanderer.say: Wei laughs -- the first time anyone's heard it. "Then go and break things that need breaking." He teaches you the Canon anyway, and gives you Kuo's old travelling bracer.

quests.name: Listening to the Willows
quests.pitch: Master Hu speaks without opening her eyes. "The willows say a stranger is clumsy with living things. Gather what grows below -- gently -- and come and sit under my tree. Then they'll decide about you."

stages.log: Gather 6 herbs from the deep (pick them, don't tear them)
Go down as far as the Drowned Seam (Floor 3)
Sit with Master Hu under the willows

default.say: You sit. Nothing happens for a long time. Then a willow leaf lands in your lap, and Hu smiles. "They've decided." She lets you keep the leaf.

quests.name: The Bending Lesson
quests.pitch: "A willow survives the storm because it bends. Slip fifteen blows. Gather more of what grows. Clear a tower floor without breaking. Disciple Mei will tell me if you've learned anything."

stages.log: Slip 15 blows (roll through them)
Gather 8 herbs
Clear a floor of any valley tower
Report to Disciple Mei

default.say: Mei hands you a flute cut from willow. "Play it when you sit. The grove will hear you from anywhere."

quests.name: The Strangled Grove
quests.pitch: "Below us, a grove has gone wrong. The Strangling Grove. Its heart-tree was ours once -- a cutting from our oldest willow. Something has wrapped round it and is squeezing. Go and see. Bring Disciple Shen the cutting's last seed, and decide with him what we do."

stages.log: Find the heart-tree's last seed in the Strangling Grove (Floor 6)

find.what: a green seed in a strangled root

stages.say: The seed is warm, and it beats like a pulse. Above it the strangling vines tighten.

stages.log: Defeat the Strangler at the Heart
stages.say: The vines go slack all at once. The grove breathes out.

stages.log: Bring the seed to Disciple Shen

choices.text: "Plant it here in the valley. Start again."
"Plant it back where it fell. The grove deserves it."

plant.say: Shen plants it by the old willow. By morning it's a sapling, and Master Hu teaches you the Bending Bough beneath it.

return.say: You go back down together. In the cleared grove the seed takes at once -- and the herbs around it double overnight. Hu teaches you the Bending Bough, and the deep folk hear about it.

quests.name: The First Willow
quests.pitch: "Every willow in the grove came from one tree, and that tree grew in the Crimson Canopy before the canopy turned red. A cutting of it still lives -- I've dreamed it. You're Core now. Bring it home."

stages.log: Reach the Crimson Canopy (Floor 12)
Find the First Willow's cutting in the Crimson Canopy

find.what: a pale willow twig among red leaves

stages.say: Among all that red, one twig is green, and it bends toward you.

stages.log: Defeat the Crimson Warden that guards it
stages.say: The Warden falls. For a moment the canopy above flickers green.

stages.log: Bring the cutting to Master Hu

default.say: Hu weeps, which none of the disciples have seen. She binds a sliver of the cutting into a charm for you. "It heals what it's near. Stay near it."

quests.name: The Storm That Prunes
quests.pitch: "The willow bends -- but our creed also says the storm prunes the weak. I've taught you to bend. Now learn to be the storm. Summit a tower. Win five bouts. And go down to the Black Canopy, where the rot began."

stages.log: Stand on the summit of a valley tower
Win 5 bouts on the valley road
Defeat the Rot-Crowned Ancient in the Black Canopy (Floor 41)
stages.say: It falls like an old tree, slowly and then all at once. The rot goes out of the wood around you.

stages.log: Return to Master Hu

choices.text: "I'll stay and guard the grove."
"I'll be the storm out in the world."

heir.say: Hu gives you her place under the oldest willow, and the canon that goes with it.

wanderer.say: "Then blow," says Hu, "and come back when you need to bend again." She teaches you the canon and gives you a willow seed for the road.

quests.name: The Narrow Path
quests.pitch: Master Ling pours tea for two and drinks both. "The path up here is narrow so that only the patient climb it. Read what the old stones below have to say -- two of them -- and come back. The tea will be fresh."

stages.log: Read 2 of the old stones in the deep
Come back up the narrow path to Master Ling

default.say: The tea is fresh. Ling listens to what you read, and corrects one word. She gives you a bead of pearl from the mist. "It remembers rain."

quests.name: Rain in the Bowl
quests.pitch: "Water takes the shape of what holds it. So will you. Catch three fish from the deep's waters. Read three more stones. Clear two floors of a tower without hurrying. Then show Disciple Bao your bowl."

stages.log: Catch 3 fish
Read 3 more of the old stones
Clear 2 floors of any valley tower
Show Disciple Bao your bowl

default.say: Bao fills your bowl with rain from the eaves and tells you to drink it slowly. It's the best water you've ever tasted. The bowl is yours.

quests.name: The Drowned Bell
quests.pitch: "Our monastery had a bell, once. The flood that made the Drowned Palace took it down with the palace. Disciple Ren says he hears it at night. I think Ren is right. Find it -- and whatever has been ringing it."

stages.log: Find the monastery bell's clapper in the Drowned Palace (Floor 11)

find.what: a bronze bell-clapper green with age

stages.say: The clapper is green and cold. Somewhere deeper, something is still swinging the bell without it.

stages.log: Lay the Bell-Drowned Abbot to rest
stages.say: The drowned thing in monk's robes sinks, and the ringing stops.

stages.log: Bring the clapper to Disciple Ren

choices.text: "Raise the bell again. Let it ring."
"Leave it silent. The drowned abbot earned his rest."

ring.say: The monks haul the bell up the cliff path over three days. When it rings, the mist parts for a mile. Ling teaches you Yielding Flow while it's still sounding.

silent.say: Ren buries the clapper under the courtyard where the river reaches. "The quiet is his," he says. Ling teaches you Yielding Flow in that quiet, and you understand more of it.

quests.name: The Tide-Mirror
quests.pitch: "The first abbot kept a mirror of still water that never spilled. She carried it into the Singing Crystal Caverns to listen to the deep, and the caverns kept her. You are Core now. Bring the mirror home."

stages.log: Reach the Singing Crystal Caverns (Floor 19)
Find the Tide-Mirror in the Singing Crystal Caverns

find.what: a disc of water standing on its edge

stages.say: A disc of water stands upright on the stone, perfectly still, reflecting a sky that isn't there.

stages.log: Silence the Resonant Choir-Mother
stages.say: The crystals stop singing. In the silence you hear water dripping, far up, from the monastery.

stages.log: Bring the Tide-Mirror to Master Ling

default.say: Ling looks into the mirror and sees the first abbot looking back. They nod to each other. "Carry it," Ling says. "It wants to see more of the world."

quests.name: Ten Thousand Rivers
quests.pitch: "All rivers come back to the sea. Climb a tower to its top. Win five bouts without anger. Then go to the Tidewrecked Court, where the flood began, and end it. Come back and tell me where you'll flow next."

stages.log: Stand on the summit of a valley tower
Win 5 bouts on the valley road
Defeat the Flood Sovereign in the Tidewrecked Court (Floor 27)
stages.say: The water drains out of the palace in one long breath. For the first time in a thousand years its floor is dry.

stages.log: Tell Master Ling where you'll flow

choices.text: "Back here. To the sea."
"Onward. Rivers don't stop."

heir.say: Ling pours tea for two and, this time, gives you the second cup. She teaches you the canon of Ten Thousand Rivers.

wanderer.say: "Then go," Ling says. "The sea will still be here." She teaches you the canon, and fills a gourd for you with water from the courtyard.

quests.name: Behind the Waterfall
quests.pitch: Master Shen has to shout over the waterfall. "You found the caves! Most don't. Now find out if you last. Twenty kills in the deep, and get down to the Nanite Sanctum. Then come back through the water."

stages.log: Defeat 20 foes in the deep
Reach the Nanite Sanctum (Floor 4)
Come back through the waterfall to Master Shen

default.say: Shen slaps your shoulder hard enough to bruise. "You lasted." He gives you a pebble from the bottom of the falls, worn smooth by a thousand years. "So will you."

quests.name: Weight of the Mountain
quests.pitch: "A brother carries. Bring the stores two good stones from the deep -- jade, if you can find it. Put forty more foes down. Then tell Disciple Qiu, who has carried water up the cave stair every day for nine years."

stages.log: Dig up 2 gems or stones
Defeat 40 foes
Give the brotherhood's stores your earth materials (talk to Master Shen)
Report to Disciple Qiu

default.say: Qiu buckles a broad belt of plaited stone-fibre round your waist. "For carrying," he says. It is heavier than it looks, and it makes you steadier than you were.

quests.name: The Clay Brother
quests.pitch: "In the Terracotta Barrows there's a clay soldier that wears our mark. Disciple Tao swears it's his grandfather, who went down a hundred years ago and never came up. Find the mark. Find the soldier. Then Tao will need someone beside him."

stages.log: Find the brotherhood's mark in the Terracotta Barrows (Floor 8)

find.what: the brotherhood's mark, cut into clay

stages.say: The mark is cut deep into a clay breastplate -- the old way, the way Shen still cuts it.

stages.log: Free the Clay Brother
stages.say: The clay cracks, and for a moment there's a face in it -- tired, then at peace.

stages.log: Tell Disciple Tao

choices.text: "He's free now. Bury the mark with honour."
"Keep it. Carry him with you."

honour.say: The whole brotherhood carries the shard to the waterfall and gives it to the water. Shen teaches you Mountain Root on the wet stones afterward.

carry.say: Tao wears the shard on a cord. "He'll see the sky again, through me." He teaches you Mountain Root himself, the way his grandfather taught his father.

quests.name: The First Heartstone
quests.pitch: "Every brother carries a heartstone. The first one -- the founder's -- is still in the dragon's spine, where he lay down to sleep and never woke. You're Core now. Go and wake him, or at least take his heart home."

stages.log: Reach the Spine of the Sleeping Dragon (Floor 17)
Find the founder's heartstone in the Spine of the Sleeping Dragon

find.what: a stone that beats

stages.say: A stone the size of a fist, warm, with a beat you feel in your teeth.

stages.log: Defeat the Spine-Warden that grew around him
stages.say: The Warden falls, and the whole floor shifts -- as if the dragon turned over in its sleep.

stages.log: Bring the heartstone home to Master Shen

default.say: Shen sets the stone against your chest. Its beat falls into time with yours. "He chose you," Shen says, and doesn't argue with it.

quests.name: The Unmoving Mountain
quests.pitch: "A mountain doesn't move -- but it's still there when the storm's gone. Summit a tower. Win five bouts. Then go to the Dragon's Ribs, where the dragon's heart is, and stand in front of what lives there. Come back and tell me what you'll be."

stages.log: Stand on the summit of a valley tower
Win 5 bouts on the valley road
Defeat the Dragon's Heart-Guard in the Dragon's Ribs (Floor 31)
stages.say: It strikes you a dozen times and you don't move. Then you strike it once.

stages.log: Tell Master Shen what you'll be

choices.text: "The mountain. Here."
"The road. Out there."

heir.say: Shen cuts the brotherhood's mark into your heartstone with his own knife, the mark only the head may wear, and teaches you the Unmoving Mountain.

wanderer.say: "A road is just a long mountain lying down," Shen says. He teaches you the canon, and gives you a walking staff of waterfall stone.

quests.name: Silver Under the Leaves
quests.pitch: Master Yun is older than the trees, and says so. "Everything that grows teaches, if you're slow enough to learn. Bring me six spirit herbs, picked whole. Not five. Not seven."

stages.log: Bring 6 Spirit Herbs
Bring the herbs to Master Yun

default.say: Yun counts them twice. "Six." He gives you a leaf of real silver, from a tree that grew it. "Things you look for will find you sooner now."

quests.name: The Grove-Keeper's Round
quests.pitch: "A keeper walks the grove every day and notices what changed. Gather ten more things that grow. See two of the deep's great sights. Then walk the round with Disciple Yan and tell her what you noticed."

stages.log: Gather 10 herbs
See 2 of the deep's great sights (landmarks)
Walk the round with Disciple Yan

default.say: Yan gives you the keeper's satchel -- the one with the pocket inside the pocket. "For the things you didn't know you'd need."

quests.name: Spore and Root
quests.pitch: "Decay is sacred too. But what's happening in the Spore-Choked Deeps isn't decay -- it's hunger. Disciple Zhi has been studying it. Bring back a sample of the mother-spore, and end the thing that grows it. Zhi will know what to do with it. Or think he will."

stages.log: Take a mother-spore from the Spore-Choked Deeps (Floor 14)

find.what: a glowing spore-cap the size of a fist

stages.say: It pulses slowly, and the spores around it turn to follow you.

stages.log: Destroy the Hunger in the Mycelium
stages.say: The threads go grey and still. The air is suddenly easier to breathe.

stages.log: Bring the spore to Disciple Zhi

choices.text: "Study it. Learn how to heal what it spoils."
"Burn it. Some things shouldn't be learned."

study.say: Zhi studies it for a month and learns how rot turns back into soil. Master Yun teaches you the Cycle of Leaf and Root from what he finds.

burn.say: The spore burns blue. Zhi is angry for a day and grateful for a week. Yun teaches you the Cycle anyway -- "you understood the important half."

quests.name: Seed of the Elder Tree
quests.pitch: "The grove's elder tree spun its seeds into silk, and the silk was stolen by a weaver in the deep. The Weaver's Halls. You're Core -- you'll know a stolen thing when you see it. Bring one seed home."

stages.log: Reach the Weaver's Halls (Floor 22)
Find the Elder Tree's seed in the Weaver's Halls

find.what: a seed wound in silver silk

stages.say: The silk unwinds at your touch, as if it had been waiting.

stages.log: Defeat the Silk-Thief
stages.say: The weaver's threads go slack. Somewhere a loom stops.

stages.log: Bring the seed to Master Yun

default.say: Yun doesn't plant it. He gives it back to you. "It wants to be carried. Things that want to be carried find the best things for their carriers."

quests.name: Wisdom of the Ages
quests.pitch: "I'm older than the trees, I said. Not older than what's below. Summit a tower. Read five of the old stones. Then go to the Rotting Bloom, where the hunger started, and end it for good. Then tell me what you'll keep."

stages.log: Stand on the summit of a valley tower
Read 5 of the old stones
Defeat the Mother of Hunger in the Rotting Bloom (Floor 28)
stages.say: The great growth collapses into clean soil. Something green is already pushing up through it.

stages.log: Tell Master Yun what you'll keep

choices.text: "The grove. I'll keep the grove."
"What I've learned. I'll keep walking."

heir.say: Yun gives you the grove-keeper's staff and the Wisdom of the Ages, the canon he has carried since before the trees.

wanderer.say: "Good," Yun says. "Wisdom that stays still goes to seed." He teaches you the canon and gives you a pressed silver leaf for every year he's lived. It's a thick book.

quests.name: A Candle in the Wind
quests.pitch: Master Xi lights a candle and hands it to you in the wind off the red lake. It doesn't go out. "Good. Bring me ember root from below, and kill one of the deep's marked things -- the ones that glow. Fire knows fire."

stages.log: Bring 3 Ember Root
Defeat an elite foe (one that glows)
Bring the ember root to Master Xi

default.say: Xi crushes the roots into the candle's flame, and it burns red. She seals a single cinder in glass for you. "It will never go out. Neither should you."

quests.name: Through the Braziers
quests.pitch: "The crucible is where the weak burns off. Put down three of the marked ones. Win two bouts. Bring the stores five more ember roots. Then walk the ring of braziers with Disciple Ping and don't flinch."

stages.log: Defeat 3 elite foes
Win 2 bouts on the valley road
Gather 5 Ember Root
Walk the braziers with Disciple Ping

default.say: You walk the ring. Ping drapes the crimson veil over your shoulders at the end -- singed at the edges, the way they all are.

quests.name: The Forge That Went Cold
quests.pitch: "Disciple Wen's family kept a forge in the Ember Forges -- until something drank the fire out of it. Bring Wen the forge's last coal, and kill the thing that's drinking. Then help Wen decide what to do with a cold forge."

stages.log: Find the forge's last coal in the Ember Forges (Floor 7)

find.what: a coal still faintly red

stages.say: A single coal, the last warm thing in a cold forge.

stages.log: Destroy the Ember-Drinker
stages.say: It bursts like a sack of sparks. Behind you, the forge coughs and catches.

stages.log: Bring the coal to Disciple Wen

choices.text: "Relight your family's forge."
"Bring the coal into the sect's braziers. Your family is here now."

relight.say: Wen goes home for a month and the forge has never burned hotter. Master Xi teaches you the Crucible Heart while you wait.

sect.say: The coal goes into the great brazier and the whole cliff glows for a night. Xi teaches you the Crucible Heart in its light.

quests.name: The Red Lake's Brazier
quests.pitch: "The lake below our cliff is red because of what was poured into it: the founder's brazier, thrown down so no one else could have it. It washed down into the deep, into the Ash Dunes. You're Core. Bring it back up."

stages.log: Reach the Ash Dunes (Floor 23)
Find the founder's brazier in the Ash Dunes

find.what: a bronze brazier full of red sand

stages.say: Half-buried, still warm. The sand in it glows when you breathe on it.

stages.log: Defeat the Dune-Wyrm of Cinders
stages.say: The wyrm sinks into its own ash. The dunes are quiet.

stages.log: Bring the brazier to Master Xi

default.say: Xi lights it with her own breath and hands it to you, burning. "The founder threw it away so no one could carry it. You carried it. It's yours."

quests.name: Burned Away, Forged Anew
quests.pitch: "The last trial of the Veil is to burn. Summit a tower. Put down five more of the marked ones. Then go into the Ember Nest, where the firebirds are born, and walk out again. Then tell me what you've become."

stages.log: Stand on the summit of a valley tower
Defeat 5 more elite foes
Face the Ash-Mother in the Ember Nest (Floor 30)
stages.say: She burns you to the bone, and you burn back hotter. When the smoke clears you're both still there -- and she bows.

stages.log: Tell Master Xi what you've become

choices.text: "The Veil's fire. I'll keep it burning here."
"A spark. I'll carry it everywhere."

heir.say: Xi gives you her own veil and the canon that goes with it: Burned Away, Forged Anew.

wanderer.say: "Sparks start fires," Xi says, and almost smiles. She teaches you the canon and gives you a firebird feather from the Nest.

quests.name: Six Banners, One Valley
quests.pitch: "Six sects in one valley, and they've not sat at one table in forty years. The Pagoda wants to host a council. Carry my invitations -- Iron Fist, Crimson Veil and Misty Peak first; the rest will follow if those three come."

stages.log: Carry Elder Bai's invitation to Master Wei (Iron Fist Clan, in the valley)
Carry the invitation to Master Xi (Crimson Veil)
Carry the invitation to Master Ling (Misty Peak)
Tell Elder Bai who's coming

default.say: "All three? In forty years--" Bai has to sit down. He gives you a pagoda token: anyone in the Pagoda will know you carried the banners.

quests.name: The Grand Tournament of Six Sects
quests.pitch: "A council needs a tournament -- something to fight about that isn't each other. Win five bouts on the valley road and climb three tower floors, and you'll stand for the Pagoda in the final."

stages.log: Win 5 bouts on the valley road
Clear 3 floors of any valley tower
Report to Lady Xiu for the final

default.say: The final is fought on the Pagoda's sixth tier with all six banners watching. You win it with a form none of them have seen -- a little of each of them. Lady Xiu names it.

quests.name: The Oathbreaker of the Ninth Tier
quests.pitch: "Forty years ago the sects swore a covenant on the Pagoda's ninth tier. One of the signers broke it, took the covenant scroll and fled into the Frozen Archive. If the council is going to mean anything, we need that scroll -- and someone has to decide what to do with it."

stages.log: Find the covenant scroll in the Frozen Archive (Floor 24)

find.what: a scroll sealed with six seals

stages.say: Six seals, one broken. The ice around it has been carved with six names, one scratched out.

stages.log: Defeat Oathbreaker Gu
stages.say: Gu falls, and the scratched-out name on the ice fills back in.

stages.log: Bring the scroll to Elder Bai

choices.text: "Bind them to the covenant again."
"Burn it. Let them choose each other freely."

bind.say: The six elders re-seal the covenant on the ninth tier, and add a seventh seal: yours.

burn.say: The scroll burns in six colours. For a long time nobody speaks. Then Master Wei offers Master Ling his hand, and she takes it. Nobody made them.

reward.title: The One Who Burned the Covenant

quests.name: What the Moon Forgot
quests.pitch: "The monastery's history was written on three pages that the archive below swallowed. Without them we don't know why we keep the vigil -- only that we do. Find the pages."

stages.log: Find the three lost pages in the Thawed Archive (Floor 42)

find.what: a page of moon-pale vellum

stages.say: Vellum so thin the light comes through. The ink is in a hand nobody here writes any more.

stages.log: Bring the pages to Sister Hush

default.say: Hush reads them by moonlight and is quiet a long time. "We keep the vigil so the Heart remembers someone is watching." She gives you the archive's old reading-stone.

quests.name: The Silent Lesson
quests.pitch: (Old Mother Silence doesn't speak. She points at the old stones on the wall, then at a riddle-stone, then at you, then at her own eyes.)

stages.log: Read 3 of the old stones
Solve a riddle-stone
Sit before Old Mother Silence

default.say: She looks at you for a very long time. Then she closes her eyes, and you understand something without either of you saying it. (You have learned the Moonless Mind.)

quests.name: Moon Over the Abyss
quests.pitch: "The pages say the first abbot carried a mirror that showed the moon even underground -- and that something below ate the moon out of it. It's in the Starless Pit. Bring it back, and the monastery will have its moon again."

stages.log: Find the Hollow Moon Mirror in the Starless Pit (Floor 44)

find.what: a dark mirror with no reflection

stages.say: Black glass, reflecting nothing -- not even you.

stages.log: Defeat the Moon-Eater
stages.say: When it falls, the mirror in your pack starts to glow.

stages.log: Bring the mirror to Abbot Lune

default.say: Lune holds up the mirror and a full moon shines out of it across the whole monastery. Then he puts it back in your hands. "A moon belongs in the sky. The deep is your sky."

quests.name: A Guest of the {sect}
quests.pitch: {elder} studies you. "Guests of the {sect} earn their tea. Twenty foes in the deep, and come back and tell me how it felt."

stages.log: Defeat 20 foes in the deep
Come back to {elder}

default.say: {elder} nods once. "Not nothing." A small token of the {sect} is yours.

quests.name: Outer Court of the {sect}
quests.pitch: "An outer disciple serves. Clear two tower floors, give the stores what {el} you carry, and report to {d1}."

stages.log: Clear 2 floors of any valley tower
Give the sect's stores your {el} materials (talk to {elder})
Report to {d1}

default.say: {d1} gives you the {sect}'s sash.

quests.name: The {sect}'s Lost Disciple
quests.pitch: "A disciple of ours went down to the Sword Grave and didn't come back. Bring back what's left, and settle whatever kept them."

stages.log: Defeat the Grave-Keeper in the Sword Grave (Floor 9)
stages.say: The Grave-Keeper falls. Among its blades, one wears the {sect}'s colours.

stages.log: Tell {d2}

default.say: {d2} takes it hard, then takes it well. {elder} teaches you the {sect}'s inner way.

quests.name: The Founder of the {sect}
quests.pitch: "Our founder's relic waits in the Thunderhead Spire. You're Core now. Bring it home."

stages.log: Find the founder's relic in the Thunderhead Spire (Floor 16)

find.what: the founder's relic

stages.say: It's warm, and it knows the {sect}.

stages.log: Bring it to {elder}

default.say: {elder} puts it in your hands. "Carry it."

quests.name: Heart of the {sect}
quests.pitch: "Stand on a tower's summit and win five bouts. Then come and tell me who you'll be."

stages.log: Stand on the summit of a valley tower
Win 5 bouts on the valley road
Answer {elder}

choices.text: "The {sect} is my home."
"I'll carry it into the world."

wanderer.say: {elder} lets you go, and teaches you the canon anyway.

mask_maker.name: The Mask Maker
mask_maker.description: A mysterious artisan in the ruins seeks rare materials to craft a legendary mask.

steps.text: Find the Mask Maker in the Ruins.
Bring the required materials to the Mask Maker.
